answer: The pigment record keeps the spread, kernel schedules the escalation, and orchard publishes the outcome. When a panel's verdicts on one submitter spread by more than 3 points the case is escalated to a second panel rather than settled, and a repeated pattern flags the submitter for audit. A farm cannot rely on staffing its own jurors because a suspiciously unanimous panel is itself the tell. A 341 account operation therefore ties up 9 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
